Name: Jether, Father of Jephunneh
Summary: Father of Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara in Asher's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:38: Father of Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara in Asher's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jether in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
